title: PDF Accessibility Basics Check (ADA Title II)
description: Give a website, a list of PDF links, or both.

siteUrl.title: Website
siteUrl.description: The home page to start from. The check reads it and some of the pages it links to on the same site, pages that look like document lists (Documents, Agendas, Forms, Library and the like) first, then checks the PDFs linked from them.

pdfUrls.title: PDF links
pdfUrls.description: Optional: PDF links to check directly (up to 200), with or without a website.

maxPages.title: Pages to read
maxPages.description: How many of the site's pages to read, besides the home page, looking for PDF links. Reading stops early once there are twice as many PDF links as PDFs to check.

maxPdfs.title: PDFs to check from the website
maxPdfs.description: How many readable PDFs to check from the website (links given in PDF links are all checked).
